name: Cosme
summary: Cosme is a relaxed shared-plates Peruvian restaurant for travelers who want a top-ranked Lima meal without formality or the highest tasting-menu prices, and it is much easier to book than the destination rooms. The 9-course tasting gets mixed reports, so order à la carte for consistency; skip it if you want precise avant-garde cooking.
